## Outcome
Project GoalBuddy and WorkGraph truth into a deterministic GitHub umbrella preview.

## Scope
Read:
- docs/goals/orcastrata-aol-github-umbrella-v1/state.yaml
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/scripts/workgraph_goalbuddy_adapter.py

Write:
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/scripts/github_umbrella_projection.py
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/assets/contracts/github-umbrella-projection-v1.md
- tests/test_github_umbrella_projection.py

## Non-goals
- A second board
- GitHub effects
- A new graph engine

## Acceptance criteria
- One valid dependency graph and byte-stable preview exist without GitHub or GoalBuddy mutation.

## Validation
- `VAL-T040` — Run projection, GitHub-read, native-interface, release-parity, GoalBuddy, and audit checks. → All selected checks pass.

## Dependencies
- T030

## Stop condition
Stop if projection requires a new truth store or incompatible schema.

## Orcastrata state
- Work item: `T040`
- GoalBuddy status: `done`
